findings.description: ZZZClaimRouter.claimBatch(ZZZClaimRouter.Claim[]) (src/ZZZClaimRouter.sol#48-74) has external calls inside a loop: target = access.module(Ids.REWARDS) (src/ZZZClaimRouter.sol#69)
findings.rationale:
1..32 claim tuples. Duplicate nested scan at most496 comparisons, with at most32 payout calls.
Router is nonreentrant and has fixed NFT/royalty destinations. Full owner/duplicate preflight precedes any payout; the second loop repeats current-owner check and each ledger repeats it again. A prior ETH/token payout callback transferring an NFT cannot redirect a later old-owner claim. Ledgers pay the authenticated current owner directly, never router-selected recipient. Any failure rolls the whole batch back.
Bounded atomic claim batch; a failing selected asset/receiver may reject the whole batch. Users may split/omit failing tuples. No universal worst-case payout gas guarantee.

findings.description:
ZZZCanonicalLedger._canonicalBalance(address) (src/base/ZZZCanonicalLedger.sol#39-41) has external calls inside a loop: IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this)) (src/base/ZZZCanonicalLedger.sol#40)
	Calls stack containing the loop:
		ZZZRoyaltyRewards.activate(uint256,uint256)
		ZZZRoyaltyRewards._sync(address)
findings.rationale:
LP Rewards assets<=33; royalty assets<=17. Royalty activate and syncAll visit<=17; canonical capture/validate/activate visit that ledger limit. CanonicalAdd duplicate checks visit<=33 or17 prior entries. No NFT-supply iteration in this balance helper.
Each balanceOf is static. Royalty activation isolates every optional ERC20 synchronization with a250000gas self-call and120000-tail requirement, preserves old eligible cohort and defers failed currencies; native synchronization has no token call. syncAll and canonical capture/validate/activate deliberately fail atomically if one required currency cannot report backing; per-asset sync remains independently callable. NFT/asset enrollment and ordinary ledger mutation are lifecycle locked during canonical transitions.
Context-specific bounded reads, not globally a harmless false positive. Optional activation faults are isolated; syncAll/canonical availability and max-currency gas remain open dependency/operating qualification.
findings.review_scope: Exact prior fingerprint and every description-referenced LF source unchanged. Prior rationale, authority and transitive-context limits retained; not a new full-transitive review.

	- (ok,None) = recipient.call{value: amount}() (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#148)
findings.rationale: Native forwarding uses call to let authenticated Vault/Buyback receive logic execute. Private _sendNative zero-skips, requires success and exact native decrease; initiating swap/balance holds nonReentrant, clears expected-credit state before delivery and checks final balances/context. Reverting recipient atomically blocks its own operation. Recipient liveness/admitted behavior remains operational risk.

findings.description: Loop condition i < settlementBuckets.length (src/ZZZMigration.sol#274) should use cached array length instead of referencing `length` member of the storage array.
findings.rationale: The settlementBuckets array is populated only during the single irreversible beginCollectiveExit, which bounds it to Vault.MAX_BUCKETS = 4; no later function mutates it. The allocation-completion loop validates every bucket's shares/ETH/ZZZ conservation before Ready under nonReentrant governance scope. Caching its storage length may be a minor optimization, but this is already a small fixed bound and no measured benefit or liveness defect was established. Do not alter critical allocation code solely to satisfy an optimization suggestion.

findings.description: The function ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.observe(uint256) (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#192-213) reads (side,identity,manual) = this.condition(bucket) (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#193-212) with `this` which adds an extra STATICCALL.
findings.rationale: The external self STATICCALL to condition is intentional: observe catches an external-read fault, clears evidence in a successful transaction and emits reset. Replacing it with an internal call would propagate revert and resurrect the old record. No other sender gets observation-write authority.
